IS_TEST().notice: Marker used by Forge to identify test contracts.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

testAbortNearCompletionThenWithdraw().notice: Abort at tick 2 of 3 (near-complete, not clean boundary).         Withdraw remaining token balance back to DAO treasury.

testCheckUpkeepReturnsFalseWhenPaused().notice: After abort, checkUpkeep must return false so Keeper stops firing.

testConsecutiveKeeperCallsAfterCompletio.notice: Two keeper calls fire back-to-back in the same block.         Second call on a completed (IDLE) vault must revert cleanly, not corrupt state.

testFullPipelineStartToCompletion().notice: Simulates the full demo path: solver outputs 3-tick schedule,         submitted to vault, keeper fires 3 times, vault reaches IDLE.

testMidFlightReoptimization().notice: Mid-flight re-optimization: after tick 0, owner submits a revised         schedule for the remaining 2 ticks. Execution resumes on new plan.

testOracleRejectsMidSchedule().notice: Oracle rejects the fill when router returns below minReturn.         - amountToSwap=1e18, oraclePrice=$10 (1e9, 8dec)         - expectedReturn = (1e18 * 1e9) / 1e20 = 10_000_000 USDC units         - minReturn at 100bps = 9_900_000         - Router returning 5_000_000 is BELOW minReturn → oracle rejects         - Router returning 15_000_000 is ABOVE minReturn → oracle passes
